name: Shounen to Tenkiame
source: The smell of rain, raindrops splashing on the cobblestones, the sound of rain dripping from the eaves. A boy was sheltering from the rain at a shrine. A slightly mysterious story that begins with an encounter with a self-proclaimed god called "Fox-san."
translation: 雨的味道，雨滴溅在鹅卵石上，雨从屋檐滴落的声音。一个男孩在神社避雨。一个略带神秘的故事，始于与自称为神的“狐狸先生”的相遇。
